description: Malawi earthquake locations (eq_loqs data) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by University of Cape Town. Earthquake Locations. ID, lon (longitude), lat (latitude), dep (depth), mag (local magnitude), time (data and time of earthquake), rms (root-mean-square error, seconds), erh (horizontal error, km), erz (depth error, km). Coverage: Malawi. The portal files it under the publisher University of Cape Town. Its tags are 40407 Seismology and Seismic Exploration, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences. The repository dates the deposit 2020; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
